description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456): `${…}` in an iframe `srcdoc` (an HTML document, i.e. script) is refused.
rationale:
§5.2 executable-sink rule: a quoted `srcdoc` attribute whose value contains `${…}` SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE). Before S456 it compiled to `setAttribute("srcdoc", `

${…}

`)` — an HTML-injection sink.
